history.summary: Plan completed and committed (f917ad5): task shape cross-cutting, two phases — P1 (Target: ansible) a renewal playbook reaching all ten leaves on ten hosts without re-declaring the per-consumer internal_tls vars and carrying serial: 1 itself on the k8s path, P2 (Target: root) the iac-scheduled-certs stages that drive it on the existing Friday cron with the devUp/UNSTABLE convention. verification.json has 15 outcome-level criteria covering R1 and both rulings, with file:line evidence verified this pass; no attachments were needed. Two close-out entries filed: the Sep 10 PVE expiry as an operator action, and the drift job's pending-renewal red turning into noise once the certs job signs.

Four blocking findings, all in P1: the "one source of truth per leaf" constraint is unsatisfiable by any route the repo offers today, the serialization invariant ignores the equally-serialized OpenBao converge path, serial: 1 silently forfeits the per-host independence the cited prior art protects, and the stalled-renewer Prometheus signal P1 and V15 rest on is recorded as deferred.

All four review findings resolved and every ruling applied; committed cc676b1. The plan is now four phases: P1 (ansible) the F1 refactor — one importable declaration per leaf including the srvk8s4 eligibility condition — plus the blast-radius limits moved into the reloads themselves; P2 (ansible) the renewal playbook, per-host independent like renew-host-certs.yml; P3 (root) the iac-scheduled-certs stages; P4 (../AnsibleSpecs) the decisions.md serialization entry the shipped diff falsifies. F3's mechanism was the planner's call per the ruling: verified against the pinned ansible-core 2.20.5 that `serial:` ends the play on the first failed one-host batch unconditionally and that max_fail_percentage cannot override it, so `serial:` is ruled out and the one-node-at-a-time guarantee lives with the restart/reload. verification.json grew to 19 criteria — V04 rewritten, V10 extended to the eligibility condition, V15 narrowed off the Prometheus claim, and V16 (coverage under failure), V17 (OpenBao peers), V18 (build-signal detector) and V19 (doctrine accuracy) added. No new close-out entries were owed; the estate observations this pass would have filed are already B1 and S1.
